grades.reason: Covers scountinhibit and counter delegation. It says nothing about medeleg or how to discover which exceptions can be delegated.

grades.quote: By default, all traps at any privilege level are handled in M-mode, though M-mode usually uses the `medeleg` and `mideleg` CSRs to delegate some traps to HS-mode.
grades.reason: Gives background that M-mode uses medeleg to delegate traps to HS-mode and that hedeleg further delegates them to VS-mode. It does not say how software discovers which exceptions medeleg can delegate, such as writing bits and reading them back as WARL.
Covers interrupt delegation through mideleg and the sip/sie views. It is about interrupts, not medeleg exceptions, and gives no discovery method.
Describes counter delegation through mcounteren, siselect and sireg. It has nothing to do with medeleg exception delegation.
